page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.3xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 12 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 6 physical Intel Xeon 8269CY processor cores operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The x86_64 architecture supports AVX and AVX-512F vector extensions, alongside AES cryptography and FMA instructions. System memory totals 96.0 GB, yielding a high resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. No local storage or dedicated GPU hardware is bundled with this instance type. Baseline network bandwidth is rated at 2 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate a clear performance profile. Single-core processing capabilities are relatively modest, with stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25% and 10% respectively. However, multi-core performance scales to average levels, as demonstrated by stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth tests show average read and write speeds, though the Passmark memory score is positioned in the bottom 25%. Database operations and Redis SET operations achieve average throughput, while static web serving and medium-sized LLM inference tasks show weaker performance.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.se1ne.3xlarge offers a high memory-to-vCPU ratio, making it a viable option for workloads requiring substantial memory capacity without demanding top-tier single-threaded CPU performance. This resource balance makes the instance suitable for memory-intensive applications such as in-memory databases, caching layers like Redis, enterprise applications, and moderate multi-threaded data processing tasks.
